name: Calm
one_liner: Meditation and sleep app with guided meditations, Sleep Stories, music and breathing exercises; mostly paid after a free trial.
best_for: Beginners who want short guided meditations
People who fall asleep better with stories, soundscapes or music
People whose employer or health plan offers Calm for free
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People with chronic insomnia or a diagnosed anxiety disorder who need treatment such as CBT-I or therapy
People who don't want their data shared for targeted advertising
short_description: Calm is a subscription meditation and sleep app with guided sessions, Sleep Stories, music and breathing exercises.
long_description: Calm, from Calm.com, Inc., offers guided meditations, Sleep Stories read by well-known voices, music and soundscapes, breathing exercises and short courses on stress, focus and sleep. A small amount of content is free; most needs Calm Premium after a 7-day trial (about $79.99/year or $16.99/month, with app-store prices varying), and some employers and health plans provide it. Randomized trials of the Calm app by university researchers found reductions in stress in college students and in daytime fatigue in adults with sleep problems. Calm's privacy policy says it does not sell data for payment but shares limited data with ad partners for targeted advertising, which can count as selling or sharing under California law; you can opt out.
patient_summary: Calm helps you relax and sleep with guided meditations, Sleep Stories, music and breathing exercises. After a 7-day trial, Premium costs about $79.99 a year or $16.99 a month, though some employers cover it. It's a wellness app rather than treatment, and it shares some data for advertising unless you opt out.

pricing.notes: 7-day free trial; a small free library. Calm raised its yearly price in February 2026 and app-store prices vary by region (some listings show $69.99/year or $14.99/month). Family plan $99.99/year for up to 6; lifetime $499.99. Some employers and plans include it.

privacy.notes: Says it doesn't sell data for payment but shares limited data with ad partners for targeted advertising (a 'sale'/'sharing' under CCPA); opt out at calm.com/optout.

seo.title: Calm: Meditation & Sleep App | HeyPsych
seo.meta_description: Calm is a meditation and sleep app with guided sessions, sleep stories, and relaxation music to reduce stress and improve sleep quality.

faqs.a: Calm offers a 7-day free trial, then costs approximately $70/year or $15/month for premium. A free version provides limited content. Lifetime subscriptions are occasionally offered. Some employers and health plans provide Calm as a covered benefit—check your benefits.

Studies show meditation apps like Calm can reduce stress and anxiety symptoms for mild to moderate concerns. Calm is a wellness tool, not clinical treatment. It works best as part of a broader self-care routine or alongside professional treatment for those with diagnosed conditions.

Sleep Stories are bedtime stories for adults, narrated by soothing voices including celebrities like Matthew McConaughey, Harry Styles, and LeBron James. The stories are designed to help you fall asleep through calming narratives and relaxing pacing.

faqs.q: How is Calm different from Headspace?
faqs.a: Both are top meditation apps. Calm emphasizes sleep content (Sleep Stories), relaxing music, and celebrity narration. Headspace focuses more on structured meditation courses and animations. Try both free trials to see which style resonates with you.
